mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO binance_c2c_order ( uid, order_number, adv_no, trade_type, asset, fiat, fiat_symbol, amount, taker_amount, total_price, unit_price, order_status, order_create_time, order_time, commission, counter_part_nick_name, advertisement_role, raw_data, sync_time ) VALUES
( #{order.uid}, #{order.orderNumber}, #{order.advNo}, #{order.tradeType}, #{order.asset}, #{order.fiat}, #{order.fiatSymbol}, #{order.amount}, #{order.takerAmount}, #{order.totalPrice}, #{order.unitPrice}, #{order.orderStatus}, #{order.orderCreateTime}, #{order.orderTime}, #{order.commission}, #{order.counterPartNickName}, #{order.advertisementRole}, #{order.rawData}, #{order.syncTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE adv_no = VALUES(adv_no), trade_type = VALUES(trade_type), asset = VALUES(asset), fiat = VALUES(fiat), fiat_symbol = VALUES(fiat_symbol), amount = VALUES(amount), taker_amount = VALUES(taker_amount), total_price = VALUES(total_price), unit_price = VALUES(unit_price), order_status = VALUES(order_status), order_create_time = VALUES(order_create_time), order_time = VALUES(order_time), commission = VALUES(commission), counter_part_nick_name = VALUES(counter_part_nick_name), advertisement_role = VALUES(advertisement_role), raw_data = VALUES(raw_data), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS rmbAmount, COALESCE(SUM(taker_amount), 0) AS usdAmount, MAX(sync_time) AS syncTime FROM binance_c2c_order WHERE uid = #{uid} AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND trade_type = 'BUY'
